flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Open Settle up and count the payments listed.
Assert Settle up lists exactly two payments.
Assert Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments or Cy is shown as paying.
Store The number of payments listed in Settle up, as a digit as 'payment_count'.
Get the number of payments listed in Settle up as a digit and save it as {{payment_count}}.

wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Name"; click "Add person"
type: Typing Rent in Bill name field
wait: queued plan (5 steps): type "Amount"; click "Ana"; click "Ben"; click "Cy"; clic
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Amount"; select "Paid by"; click "Add bill"
wait: PRIMARY: Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equ
wait: PRIMARY: Open Settle up and count the payments listed
analyze: Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments.
assert: Settle up lists exactly two payments.
assert: Ben pays Ana 300.00 appears among the payments or Cy is shown as paying.
